label: preparing
what: A coordinated great-hall gathering appears to be being prepared, with provisions including sixty-four loaves and eight donated installed lanterns. The lighting inspection tomorrow at eighteen may be a pretext for bringing me there. Given my forty years of service this year, a surprise anniversary celebration is plausible, but its purpose is not confirmed. Secretary is knowingly coordinating appointments and hall access; whether she knows any concealed celebratory purpose is uncertain.
